summary: Backend testing for iter38: PAGAMENTO IN DIREZIONE flow, brogliaccio direzione/ritenuta/rappel fields, chiusura-giorno with direzione, banca is_incassi_direzione, super-admin reset-dati + backup, copilot lowercase multi-word name. 11/12 tests PASS. 1 CRITICAL BUG confirmed: POST /api/contabilita/chiusura-giorno returns 500 because PDF generation raises ValueError('negative availWidth') when tenant has >8 conti_cassa attivi (current tenant has 13). This is the exact 'Cannot close Prima Nota - get errors' bug reported by the user.

critical.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error when generating brogliaccio PDF. Root cause: pdf_brogliaccio._calcola_larghezze() produces NEGATIVE descr_w when n_conti_cassa is large. Current tenant has 13 conti attivi (incl. duplicates 'Pagamento Direzione' + 'PAGAMENTI IN DIREZIONE'). Formula: descr_w = page_w(281mm) - fixed_w(90mm) - conti_w(15mm)*13 = -4mm. Reportlab raises: 'ValueError: Table ... flowable given negative availWidth=-23.33... width=-11.33'. This BLOCKS Prima Nota close entirely.
critical.suggested_fix: Either (a) reduce fixed_w/conti_w when many conti, (b) shrink descr min width with wrap, (c) switch to A3 landscape / dynamic page size, or (d) filter out conti with 0 activity on the day. Also address the duplicated 'Pagamento Direzione' conto_cassa which is now redundant since is_direzione flag replaces need for a bank column.

minor.issue: Duplicate/near-duplicate active conti_cassa still present: 'Pagamento Direzione' AND 'PAGAMENTI IN DIREZIONE' — user's original complaint was 'Conti Deposito duplica Banche' — recommend cleanup / hide these two conti as they are conceptually superseded by is_direzione flag on movimenti. Also affects PDF column overflow (bug above).

action_items: FIX pdf_brogliaccio._calcola_larghezze() to handle N>8 conti_cassa without producing negative descrizione column width — this unblocks POST /api/contabilita/chiusura-giorno.
Consider skipping conti_cassa with 0 activity on the day from the PDF (would also fix layout in most real cases).
Remove or archive the two 'Direzione' conti_cassa entries (now redundant with is_direzione flag) — also satisfies the user's original complaint about 'Conti Deposito duplica Banche' semantic clutter.
Consider exposing is_incassi_direzione on Banca in the librerie UI list (backend already returns it correctly).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 10912 lines — split into routers per domain (contabilita, titoli, polizze, etc.); already partially done under /routes but the huge server.py remains a maintenance risk.

_compute_brogliaccio: elif branch order is correct — is_direzione handled BEFORE fallback categories. Verified: is_dir=True on direzione titolo produces ONE riga with totale=0, spese=0, per_conto={}, saldo=-provv, direzione==provv. No duplicate rows.
incassa_titolo: correctly stores conto_cassa_id=None + importo=0 + categoria=incasso_premio_direzione + is_direzione=True when mezzo contains 'direzione'. Preserves provvigioni from titolo.
reset-dati endpoint: robust — password custode, ragione_sociale confirmation, gzipped backup BEFORE delete, safe path traversal check on download. Good defensive coding.

chiusura-giorno should try/except the PDF generation error and either continue (save chiusura without PDF) or return a meaningful 400/422 instead of 500 — currently a PDF layout issue makes the whole close endpoint unusable.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter38: the PAGAMENTO IN DIREZIONE flow works correctly on the API + brogliaccio compute layer — no duplicate rows, correct semantics. The ONLY remaining blocker is the PDF layout bug in _calcola_larghezze which makes chiusura-giorno fail with 500. After main agent fixes the PDF widths, re-run test_iter38::TestChiusuraDirezione. All other iter38 test coverage (banca is_incassi_direzione, super-admin reset+backup+download, copilot lowercase multi-word) is green.

rca_of_the_issue.bug: POST /api/contabilita/chiusura-giorno → 500 (user complaint: cannot close Prima Nota)
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: 1) Login admin. 2) Ensure tenant has >=8 active conti_cassa (this tenant has 13). 3) Ensure at least 1 movimento on target date. 4) POST /api/contabilita/chiusura-giorno {data: today}.
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: pdf_brogliaccio._calcola_larghezze() computes descr_w = 281mm - 90mm - 15mm*n_conti. For n_conti>=13, descr_w becomes negative, ReportLab crashes with 'negative availWidth'. This has nothing to do with is_direzione directly — but the presence of the two extra 'Direzione' conti_cassa contributes to inflating n_conti.
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Immediate: clamp descr_w to minimum 30mm and if page width overflows, split table into multiple pages or reduce fixed column widths dynamically. Long-term: filter conti_cassa with zero activity on the day, and clean up the two duplicate 'Direzione' conti.
